name: Greenbank Medical Practice
summary: GP surgery: patients, care homes, pharmacies and NHS partners.

company.name: Greenbank Medical Practice
company.description: A GP practice in Bristol with 11,000 registered patients, 6 GPs, nurses and an admin team. The practice receives email from patients (repeat prescriptions, test results, appointment problems, sick notes), local care homes, community pharmacies and NHS partner organisations. Clinical questions must not be answered over email by admin staff; urgent symptoms must be directed to 999 or NHS 111. The phone system was upgraded last week and patients are complaining about queues.
